title: Time Value of Money (TVM) - perpetuities (for the CFA Level 1 exam)
description:
Time Value of Money (TVM) - perpetuities (for the CFA Level 1 exam), explores the universal formula for dealing with a constant stream of level cash flows.
In order to set your calculator up properly, following the procedure laid out in this video:
